name: Banh khuc
summary: Bánh khúc is roasted pork and mung-bean paste layered in sticky rice with khúc leaves from the Red River, steamed in banana leaves.
origin: Hanoi. The walk calls it a specialty of the city.
howToEat: Steamed, wrapped in banana leaves, and served with salty peanuts and slices of pork patty.
where: A sidewalk in the Old Quarter.
seoTitle: Banh khuc — Hanoi sticky rice in khuc leaves
seoDescription: Bánh khúc in Hanoi is sticky rice with khúc leaves, roasted pork, and mung-bean paste, steamed in banana leaves and served with peanuts and pork patty.
